name: catalog-001-baseline
statements: CREATE TABLE product_presets(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(description))>0),unit_price TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND unit_price GLOB '[0-9]*.[0-9][0-9]' AND length(unit_price)-length(replace(unit_price,'.',''))=1), unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3), unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),UNIQUE(organization_id,id))STRICT
CREATE INDEX product_presets_organization ON product_presets(organization_id,description COLLATE NOCASE,id)
